purpose: Explicit owner decision: one sixth independent v6 experiment. The assembly-rendered runtime-context binding worked: the decision pre-step entered, the core system/owner/runtime-context messages and the model request header/context were emitted with the event tools mounted. The provider stream then produced an empty assistant attempt and the run was aborted, so the evaluation became CORE_EXECUTION_UNCONFIRMED; create succeeded, no retry was made.

milestone: MAJOR PROGRESS: the v6 Goal Session has 21 events and now includes step/start, the core system message, the owner user message, the host runtime-context user message, a model request/header with provider/config and the three mounted read-only event tools, and a request/context. This is the first real model request in the whole validation series.

failure.detail: The provider stream produced an empty assistant attempt (assistant/attempt stream: []) immediately after the request header/context; step/end followed and the run was aborted with the generic Core decision cancelled hook before any assistant message. local-core maps the resulting no-code error to CORE_EXECUTION_UNCONFIRMED. No token usage was reported and the reason was preserved via preStopEvaluation. The exact provider error text is not yet surfaced and must be instrumented next.
